description.value: The Drake Eatery & Craft Beer Parlour has been a fixture of Victoria's Historic Market Square since 2014, pouring West Coast craft beer across 29 rotating taps alongside a food program built on simply prepared quality local ingredients. The space is intentionally low-key — no TVs, no loud music — designed as a neighbourhood gathering spot with order-at-the-bar service. It also hosts community fundraising events, including the annual Thirsty Chef beer and food festival benefiting the Victoria Cool Aid Society.
